items.headline: Laura Rutledge shouts out her old crew during 'Nation on Location'
items.description: ESPN reporters preview the biggest Week 2 matchups from around the nation as former SEC Nation host Rutledge sends a special message to the team.

items.headline: Texas' Sarkisian describes what growth he's seen in Manning
items.description: When asked about Arch Manning's development, Steve Sarkisian credits his quarterback's mental and physical toughness last season and how he's become a true leader for the Longhorns.

items.headline: SEC Nation describes how Ohio State vs. Texas could go
items.description: Paul Finebaum says this top-five matchup is a must-win for Steve Sarkisian while the rest of the SEC Nation crew explains how the Longhorns have to show up against the Buckeyes.

items.headline: What does Arch Manning have to do for Texas vs. Ohio State?
items.description: The SEC Nation crew specifies how Manning has to continue improving and where he can step up for the No. 4 Longhorns as they host the No. 1 Buckeyes.
